_doc: CED key terms. The first time a term is spoken in an episode, a key-term chip shows its definition (derived; no beat to author). `match` lists spoken forms. Definitions: one sentence, exam-usable, consistent with data/fact-registry.json.

terms.definition: The two-way transfer of plants, animals, people, and diseases between the Americas and Afro-Eurasia after 1492.
An outbreak among people with no prior exposure to a disease; historians debate the term because it hides war, slavery, and famine.
A Spanish grant of Native labor and tribute to colonists, a system of coerced labor.
The forced Atlantic crossing of enslaved Africans to the Americas, the deadliest leg of the trade.
A 16th-century encyclopedia of Nahua life and the conquest, compiled under friar Bernardino de Sahagún with Nahua scholars.
